ana: heads-up — ran a mixed quant rollout (v2 -> v2-int4 + int8 fallback) on the beta cohort (3% traffic) for 2h. p50 -35ms, p95 -95ms, cost -16%. but we see cohort-level MRR -1.6% and anchor-concordance -1.2% on security-related prompts. proposing a graded-fallback that combines cohort/global signals before triggering hard rollback. cc @jeff @sara

jeff: can you share the numbers and sample sizes? is the anchor drop concentrated in a tiny slice?
sara: quick summary: cohort tokens ~220k, security-anchor sessions ~1.7k, cohort-MRR -1.6% (p=0.04), global MRR -0.2% (ns), hallucination +0.15pp. p95 latency improved -95ms.

jeff: ok borderline. prefer staged fallback: (1) soft hold + increased shadow sampling if anchor_drop >=1.0% AND tokens <250k, (2) auto-rollback only if (global_MRR_drop >=1.0% OR hallucination_pp >=0.5pp) OR (anchor_drop >=1.5% AND tokens >=250k AND consecutive_windows=2). also add Bayesian credible intervals for MRR smoothing, window=2h.
sara: also want a graded routing change: if a slice shows anchor drop but global stable, route that slice to int8 variant for up to 24h while rest uses int4 to preserve latency gains but mitigate behavior regressions. call it "slice-fallback-routing".

ana: typo — ana meant "slice-fallback-routing".

ops-bot: note: implementing slice-fallback-routing requires route table update and a rollback cooldown of 75 minutes. will randomize the cutover by +/-12% to avoid region sync.

ana: draft rule (yaml-style inline):

```
graded_fallback:
  min_tokens_for_hard_rollback: 250000
  anchor_soft_hold_threshold: 1.0
  anchor_hard_threshold: 1.5
  global_mrr_hard_threshold: 1.0
  hallucination_hard_pp: 0.5
  consecutive_windows_for_hard: 2
  smoothing: bayesian_cred_interval(window=2)
  slice_fallback_routing: {
    "if_anchor_drop_and_global_stable": "route_slice_to=int8 for 24h"
  }
  cooldown_minutes: 75
  jitter_pct: 12
```

jeff: small tweaks: (a) change min_tokens_for_hard_rollback to be adaptive: max(250k, slice_tokens*0.5) so tiny slices need proportionally fewer tokens to trigger. (b) cap slice_fallback_routing ramp to 5% if slice<1% traffic.

sara: also add a KL check: if top20-KL > 0.12 AND anchor_drop>=1.0% -> escalate to urgent shadow and notify #eng-ml.

canary-bot: smokecheck summary for 5423456789: cohort-MRR -1.6% (p=0.04), anchor-concordance -1.2%, p95 -95ms, cost -16%. fallback NOT triggered (tokens below hard threshold). scheduled: 24h targeted shadow for security anchors + slice routing test to int8 for that slice. link: https://ci.redwood-inference/smoke/5423456789

jeff: agreed next steps: (1) push graded_fallback rule with adaptive min_tokens, (2) start 24h shadow + slice->int8 routing at 1% for affected slice, (3) collect 500k token anchor traces overnight, (4) add dashboard: slice-level anchor-concordance, top20-KL, and Bayesian MRR CI.

sara: add alert: if global MRR drop >=0.8% for 1h -> immediate notify + hold promotions.

ana: i'll implement the promoter changes and schedule the routing experiment. will report back with 12h snapshot. thanks.
